author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with another LET'S PLAY! Today we're taking a look at upcoming 6mm Corporate Wars game OASIS. This armour-scale game features hordes of cool air, land and foot units in a multi-spectrum combat game where you're after the LOOT on an isolated alien graveyard accessible to humanity only through a flickering Jump Gate. Let's dive in!

Game Website HERE: https://www.oasiswargame.com

Check out the upcoming preorders on Gamefound next week HERE: https://gamefound.com/en/projects/collins-epic-wargames/oasis-tactical-salvage-reclamation
